subject: gk
question:
Given below are the statements in assertion and reason. Choose the correct options:

Assertion (A): AFl has incorporated WADA's 2014 anti-doping rules into its constitution.

Reason(R): Any updates to WADA rules are automatically binding on all athletes and affiliated units in AFI.

options.text: A is true, but R is false.
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is false, but R is true.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Athletics Federation of India (AFI)** has officially adopted the 2014 anti-doping rules set forth by the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) into its constitution, ensuring adherence to global anti-doping standards.
 
• WADA’s rules are binding on all athletes and affiliated units under the jurisdiction of organizations like the AFI, which is committed to maintaining fair play in athletics.
 
• The incorporation of WADA rules means that **any updates or revisions** to these anti-doping regulations are automatically enforceable under AFI’s governance.
 
• This ensures that Indian athletes and sports bodies stay aligned with international anti-doping protocols, promoting a clean and ethical sporting environment.
 
• The assertion (A) and the reason (R) are both correct, and (R) directly explains why (A) is true, as WADA's binding framework ensures automatic compliance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA):**

 
 
• WADA was established in 1999 as an international independent agency to lead the fight against doping in sports.
 
• Its primary role is to harmonize anti-doping policies, rules, and regulations globally.
 
• The WADA Code serves as a universal document for anti-doping regulations, covering prohibited substances, therapeutic use exemptions, testing, and sanctions.
 
 
 
• **Anti-Doping Rules:**
 
 
• These rules are designed to prevent the use of performance-enhancing drugs in sports.
 
• They include testing protocols, sanctions for violations, and education programs for athletes.
 
 
 
• **National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA) India:**
 
 
• NADA is the national organization responsible for implementing anti-doping measures in India.
 
• It works in collaboration with WADA to ensure compliance with international anti-doping standards.
 
 
 
• **Automatic Binding Nature of WADA Rules:**
 
 
• Organizations affiliated with WADA, like AFI, are required to automatically adopt any updates or changes to WADA’s rules.
 
• This ensures consistency in anti-doping measures across countries and sports.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Athletes:**
 
 
• All athletes under AFI’s jurisdiction must comply with WADA’s rules, including regular doping tests and adherence to the list of prohibited substances.
 
• Non-compliance may result in sanctions, including bans from competitions.
